rounds.text: Radha Madhav Corporation Ltd is exhibiting strong fundamental profit acceleration that outpaces historical trends and broader market pricing. Compounded profit growth stands at 68% over the trailing twelve months, supported by a 26% growth rate over 3 years and a 14% growth rate over 5 years [E7, E8, E9]. This earnings momentum is reinforced by strong cash generation, with operating cash flow and free cash flow both reaching Rs 5.04 Cr in March 2026 [E18, E19]. The company's financial stability has improved significantly as borrowings have been reduced to zero in September 2026, down from Rs 1.46 Cr a year earlier, establishing a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.00x [E20, E21, E35, E36]. Furthermore, the business benefits from operating within a capital goods sector that is currently experiencing a strong tailwind with a score of +0.57 and robust sector median sales and profit growth [E52, E53, E54]. The underlying fundamental improvement is further highlighted by a scanX results score of 81 out of 100 alongside accelerating earnings growth, suggesting the market is overlooking an active operational turnaround [E46, E51]. Conceded: [E1, E4, E5, E6, E10, E13, E14, E27, E30, E31, E32, E37, E38, E39, E40, E41, E47, E48, E49].

Radha Madhav Corporation Ltd trades at an exorbitant price-to-book multiple of 50.00x on a thin book value of ₹ 0.04, heavily embedding optimism into a stock that sits below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E1, E27, E49]. The company exhibits severe profitability and capital allocation flaws, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month ROCE of -7.4% and an abysmal 3-year median return on equity of -156% [E4, E13]. Operational deterioration is starkly visible in the trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of -100%, alongside inconsistent operating margins and low interest coverage [E6, E15, E16, E38]. Promoter commitment is weak and waning, with total insider holding resting at just 20.1% after experiencing a decrease of 4.88% over the last quarter [E39, E40]. Long-term wealth destruction remains a dominant feature, evidenced by a 10-year compounded share price growth of -19% and a devastating historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -99.1% coupled with an annualized volatility of 69.3% [E10, E30, E31]. conceded: [E19]

While the bear points to an elevated price-to-book ratio of 50.00x and a stock price below its moving averages, this ignores the current operational turnaround where quarterly earnings growth is accelerating with net profit surging 105% year-on-year [E1, E27, E43, E46]. The critique regarding past negative returns on equity and 10-year share price history overlooks the present fundamental acceleration, featuring robust 3-year compounded profit growth of 26% and trailing twelve-month profit growth of 68% [E8, E9, E10, E13]. Furthermore, concerns over declining sales growth and operating margin inconsistency are answered by strong cash generation, as the company produced ₹ 5.04 Cr in both operating cash flow and free cash flow [E6, E15, E16, E18, E19]. The bear's worry about low interest coverage and debt is directly countered by the company successfully reducing its borrowings to ₹ 0.00 Cr, achieving a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.00x and operating in a sector tailwind [E20, E21, E35, E36, E38, E52]. Finally, while promoter holding is cited at 20.1%, institutional backing remains stable with foreign institutions holding 1.20% unchanged, and the macro backdrop is fully supported by the Capital Goods sector tailwind score of +0.57 [E23, E24, E40, E52]. Conceded: [E1, E4, E13, E27, E30, E31, E39].

Conceded: [E43]. While the bull highlights accelerating profit growth and net profit surging 105% year-on-year, this short-term improvement completely fails to justify a staggering price-to-book ratio of 50.00x on a book value of just ₹ 0.04 [E1, E43, E46]. The bull attempts to brush aside negative return metrics, but a 3-year median ROE of -156% and a recent ROE of -30.5% point to severe historical capital destruction that a single year of cash flow cannot instantly repair [E5, E13, E18]. Furthermore, citing a debt-free status of 0.00x ignores the explicit warning that the company suffers from a low interest coverage ratio alongside shrinking trailing twelve-month sales growth of -100% [E6, E20, E38]. The bull's reliance on stable institutional ownership and sector tailwinds overlooks the precarious ownership structure, where promoter holding sits low at 20.1% and recently dropped by 4.88% in the last quarter [E23, E24, E39, E40, E52]. Finally, the claim of a strong technical setup is flatly contradicted by the fact that the stock trades below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, accompanied by a disastrous historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -99.1% and high annualised volatility of 69.3% [E27, E30, E31].
